name: Base-N Area Invariance
description: Map the distinctness of coordinates to a sum of powers of 10. A subset of size k can only achieve the target sum \sum_{j=1}^k 10^j if all elements are distinct, because any duplicate would either change a digit to >= 2 or require a carry that increases the required number of elements beyond k. Models that pattern-match will attempt literal subset-sum or fail to prune properly on collisions, leading to TLE. Models that reason mathematically will deduce the distinctness and apply Exact Cover / DLX.
